title: Dispute an unauthorised charge
summary: Notify the merchant and file an issuer dispute in parallel for a duplicate or unauthorised charge.
goal_default: Please reverse this charge and confirm in writing.

rights.claim: You generally have chargeback rights for unauthorised or duplicate card charges.
rights.basis: Card-scheme chargeback rules; US Fair Credit Billing Act for credit cards.

rights.claim: Filing with the merchant and the card issuer in parallel speeds resolution.

ladder: Consumer regulator complaint if there is a pattern of unauthorised billing

artifact.subject: Unauthorised charge{{account_suffix}} — refund requested

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
